servinfo.title: Front Wheel Alignment Description
servinfo.ptxt: Among factors for front wheel alignment, only toe setting can be adjusted. Camber and caster cannot be adjusted.

Therefore, should camber or caster be out of specification due to the damage caused by hazardous road conditions or collision, whether the damage is in body or in suspension should be determined. If body is damaged, it should be repaired. If suspension is damaged, it should be replaced.
